hed: Cool fall Monday on Table Rock — crisp air and light winds
deck: Monday, October 19, 2026 delivers pleasant fall weather with a high near 68°F and low in the mid-40s. Clear to partly cloudy skies and zero rain chance make it a perfect first-timer day for lake activities, a show, or exploring the Branson Landing.

pick.title: Table Rock Lake Fall Cruise or Paddle
pick.where: Table Rock Lake near Notch Lane and Indian Point
pick.why: Cooler water temperatures improve fishing bite for bass, crappie and trout while comfortable air temps and light winds create ideal sightseeing conditions. Morning is best before any afternoon breeze.
